messages.subject: markers
parts:
I have about 1000 markers for one of my data sets and was wondering if
it is possible to run this many markers in R/qtl at one time (since
there are only 256 columns in excel spreadsheets).

Thanks,
Abby

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: markers
parts:
Dear Abby,

Yes; the only limit is computer memory.
You might want to use the "csvr" format, in which columns and rows
are interchanged.
